fighterDuel.title: The Fighting Game
fighterDuel.help: Arrows to move and jump (↑) · J light · K heavy · L throw (hold ← to guard)
fighterDuel.help_touch: Use the buttons below to step in, jump and strike. Stepping back is your guard

rules.triangle: Throws beat guards, guards beat strikes, strikes stuff an incoming throw. An airborne body can't be thrown — and can't guard either
rules.frames: Heavy hits slow and hurts. Land one during their wind-up for a counter; land from a jump and you're the one who gets punished

m1.subject: We arrived safe
m1.b1: Your mom and I got here fine. The sea is right outside the room.
m1.b2: She keeps telling me to send photos, so here are a few. Eat properly.

m2.subject: Back the day after tomorrow
m2.b1: We had a good rest. We should be home by evening the day after tomorrow.
m2.b2: Want us to bring you anything? Write back.

n1.headline: Unexplained behavioral cases reported… health authorities investigating
n1.b1: Local hospitals report a growing number of similar symptoms. Authorities say they are not ruling out an infection.
n1.b2: Experts urge people to avoid contact and report symptoms immediately.

n2.headline: Signs of nationwide spread… government urges people to stay in
n2.b1: Cases are being reported across the country. The government has advised against all non-essential travel.
n2.b2: Major roads have begun to close.

n3.headline: BREAKING: Perimeter around the capital collapses
n3.b1: The army said at dawn today that the outer perimeter

ending.line: He opens the door and steps outside.
ending.note: The ending film goes here. Its last shot picks up exactly where you left off: bat in hand, door swinging open.

drawerNote.title: Folded Note
drawerNote.caption: Dad's handwriting. No idea when he left it here.
drawerNote.l2: Set it to the national tournament date. You'll never forget that one.

wallCalendar.title: Wall Calendar
wallCalendar.caption: Two circles. One is that day; the other is some day before it.

shelfBook.title: Book on the Shelf
shelfBook.heading: Games of the World · Playing Cards
shelfBook.l1: Four suits. Spades and clubs print in black, hearts and diamonds in red.
shelfBook.l2: Each face is printed twice, the second upside down, so either end reads the same.
shelfBook.caption: Bought it in grade school and barely opened it.

deskClock.title: Desk Clock
deskClock.heading: Numbers penciled on the ticks
deskClock.figure: A clock face marked every 45 degrees, clockwise
deskClock.l1: Start at 0 and count the way the hands turn. Half a turn is 180.
deskClock.caption: No idea when I wrote these. Bored during homework, probably.

workbook.title: Workbook on the Desk
workbook.hint: Drag to turn, scroll or use the buttons to zoom
workbook.caption: A well-thumbed math workbook. How many pages did I actually get through?

mirror.hint: Drag or use the buttons to turn
mirror.caption: …I look rough. How many days has it been like this.
